title: Peru Update — May 25, 2026
summary: Peru's 2026 post-electoral crisis concluded with the JNE certifying a Keiko Fujimori vs. Roberto Sánchez runoff for June 7, after a 35-day delay caused by ballot delivery failures, a police raid on the ONPE director, fraud claims by 3rd-place López Aliaga, and a court-ordered IT audit. Eight events were added covering the crisis from April 25 to May 25. Political profiles updated to include interim presidents José Jerí and José María Balcázar plus runoff candidates Sánchez and López Aliaga. Economic data updated with Q1 2026 GDP growth of 3.5%. Tía María copper mine permit reinstatement and the OAS statement urging vote completion were documented. A new claim on the Boluarte impeachment was added.
